title: vtc-00: livestream lifecycle with slow start/failure
description: Generic lifecycle: 'starting' may last arbitrarily long (some media pipelines take minutes to provision) and can end in failure; add a failure outcome (e.g. state 'failed' plus a server-set reason) instead of silently stopping; keep stop-before-destroy (vtc-00 L1274). Operator SHOULDs only: idle auto-stop and per-account livestream quotas (cost control). No vendor-specific state names.
